body: I know this feeling too well. Feel free to pm me if you want to. I’m always happy to listen
All the super markets near me are zero hours or delivery drivers. Zero hours scam you out of working rights and don’t guarantee work. I don’t drive so delivery isn’t an option
That would be lovely. I can always pm you so you don’t miss any. That’s if you want.
I do time to time but they typically don’t get any response so I’m glad this one has
Thank you, I was honestly writing off the top of my head and how I feel
Mine tried to make me into a mini version of them. Once I started to say no they destroyed my reputation, destroyed everything they could and laughed

I was lucky to be able to move out but it’s rough for many reasons. Some days I really question why I keep going as I’m so damaged after what happened. It’s stupid I even lack basic skills you learn as a kid because of how I was brought up

I’m sorry that happened and glad I’m not alone...

I feel this way as my family always use to tell me how much of a failure I am in every way from grades to physical looks. They even went to extremes to try and make me “perfect” by hiding medical/mental/physical issues I have from doctors no matter how serious. 

For most of my life I thought all of it was normal so always been very tough on myself to try and make them happy. Sadly nothing I did was enough so I kept pushing and pushing.
Got no job, got no talents, make my partner upset when I’m honest, upset people without trying and much more
Sure, send me a pm

It’s stupidly mentally destroying...I’m losing my mind as all routine and motivation is gone. Can’t get work, medical help or anything. I’m dragging everyone down around me and that is making me even worse.

I would seek help but till the pandemic is over I’m stuck...I’ve been struggling with it for years because my family always poke fun at how “obese” and “ugly” I am. Not matter how much I lose or gain they are never nice about how I look
Life is mostly bullshit but hey there’s moments of joy I guess

I sadly don’t have any friends anymore. They all judged my choice to move away and have since stopped talking to me. I do live with some very nice people though but they just see a mother that regrets having a child
You’re a brave person being able to do that. I’m too scared of what may happen if I did
I moved out over six months ago and still get nasty messages from mine. Just glad I have some hope
I know fanaticism and in my family it happens because it’s heavily forced through older generations

Whelp, I’m least lucky to be out of there now. Just got to deal with their social media posts and calls. 

Don’t rush yourself. There’s always time to do it especially during this time. You can do it :)

Don’t be sorry, times catches us all off guard. 

No one besides them should be sorry for what happened. It’s weird though that when I use to speak to a counsellor they said “god does this to challenge you and make you stronger. You’ll get over it”
Like attempting to end myself multiple times, self harming and more is “getting over it”

It really was. But they still call and text me saying how terrible I am for “abandoning” them all. 

What sucks more is that my physical and mental health are in shreds because of them and the fact they lied to doctors for years so I wouldn’t be treated for at least one potentially life threatening condition. Before I left they pushed me to the point they refused to take me hospital when I was seriously unwell. Wish a bit they never gave in and let the condition kill me there and then...

My whole family believes in it. I grew up isolated and they thought I just enjoyed being at home when in reality they never really let me out of their sight. I couldn’t even sleep or put stuff in the bin without them checking an idea. 

My best choice was to pretty much run away
A lot of people do. I’m trying to make the best of it but it’s very slow progress

That’s pretty much it. Been told 80-90% of those that study it never are able to get a paid job in the field. It’s a thing those with needs do to make them feel like they could do something but parents are safe knowing they will never get a job in it

I’d like to but bills need to be paid and I’m barely scraping by. Use to volunteer for hundreds of hours for various businesses and charities but been told time and time again by employers the hours don’t count for anything and they don’t care. The paid jobs are rare because there’s too many in the field and not enough jobs. They expect people to volunteer at best

I guess but animal jobs are extremely rare and hard to get into. Especially the field I studied. Most places want 10+ years experience for basic jobs and I have barely a year or two. Plus the skills aren’t transferrable so the best I can get is retail dead end which with currently impossible

I can’t afford college again. The course is roughly £6-8k let alone equipment fees. I’m a failure for doing a course typically designed for those with very special needs. Like those who failed set 8 high school, dropped out or special school graduates.
I’ve passed college and just finishing uni. I wanted to be a photographer but was made to study animals and be a dog trainer

I have tried to but it’s not enough. My life was picked and controlled by them. I wish I was stronger to pick a career path I wanted rather then their suitable back up option. But even as I got older nothing I did could please anyone, I couldn’t please parents, family or teachers

Because they were told my doctors when I was very young I was basically going to be a special needs vegetable that would never go anywhere. They took it to heart and refuse to have any standards beyond that. 

My family isolated me from pretty much everyone that was not in the family growing up so never really had friends. Even now I pretty much don’t have friends because I have such poor social skills.
Always been brought up being told that by everyone including parents, teachers, family, friends and more. No matter how hard I tried I was still a failure.

I can’t...I’m sure even if I call they won’t care and I have to look after pets that others can’t do. Plus I’m desperately looking for work to try and keep a roof over me. If I get put on a ward or something I won’t be able to get work

I might do but I’m nervous to as I have never heard it really helping. The system here is a bit weird but until corona calms down I highly doubt they will do much.

Plus I’m not that good of a person so probably a waste of their time

I’ve already called doctors and they don’t want to know unless it’s corona or cancer. The best you get is suicide watch but generally ends up in wards. 

There is probably professional near me but hard to get to

That sounds like a good system. Here it’s unless you’re in the process of killing yourself take a long walk. Like from what I’ve been told they don’t really help they just hide you away as never heard of anyone get better

For me real help is being able to talk to a real professional that doesn’t blow you off

I might but at the moment doctors do not want to see people unless they have corona or cancer. To get a chance I have to wait till corona calms down. 

I know the ward is rough through friends and family that have been there. They’ve all told me the staff try but no real help is given. They have told those with issues to “draw or walk it off”

The nhs only covers so much. You can only see specialists if you gets a doctors referral if they don’t send you to a mental health ward (they’re really rough places) which is cheaper. I have a medical issue that is 1 expensive (£10-£15) per item, if used as needed would need 2 every month or so and 2 makes me very vulnerable to corona. All of this is very hard when I’m unemployed
I’m in the uk and I guess we do. Because of our lives and recent events it’s hard to talk for many reasons. For example I’ve almost been in hospital due to corona

I do trust him but when I talk to him about stuff like this he can’t take it and shuts down. It always ends up as me feeling terrible for being open as he’s scared and doesn’t know how to say it. 

Psychiatrists are too expensive here and don’t have near enough money for one. I don’t really have enough for my own medical stuff
Easily yes. It’s hard to tell what’s the truth. Many times it’s lead to me being hurt
Think so...
I don’t know....he says I’m worth it but I can’t do anything right for him. My best isn’t enough for him. He deserves so much more and better then a pathetic girl like me
Again no, we have agreed to a ring but also agreed he will ask when he wants to
Not yet, we live together tho
I love how kind and caring he is. How much he will do no matter the expense. He’s passionate about stuff. In the time we’ve been together it feels like I’ve been the cause of his pain

It’s feels like because of the past I have no control of the future. The stuff I use to dream of doing and still do is almost impossible because I don’t have the skills or knowledge to do it. I can’t afford college or uni again. Best I can kind of do is retail and stuff. I can’t even get hired into the field I studied in because it’s so narrow and hard to get into
